lost_bodies._data_status_note: No public register of Ahmedabad's lost lakes has been found, so none can be placed in wards.

flood._data_status_note: AMC identifies 148 waterlogging spots (July 2026) but has not published the list or their locations, so they cannot be placed in wards.

drainage._data_status_note: AMC reports 1,010 km of storm-water drains (Budget 2026-27) but publishes no drain geometry.

sewerage._data_status_note: AMC's sewage treatment plants are named in its budget and in GPCB filings, but no plant or pumping-station locations are published.

industrial._data_status_note: GPCB publishes no coordinates for the common effluent treatment plants or the industrial units that discharge to the Sabarmati.
